messages:
mina (new hire): hey team, first week here — quick Q: where do we keep the canonical meeting-notes templates in Notion? i want one that wires into the action-items tracker and calendar link.

sam (DevEx): welcome mina! :wave: we keep meeting note templates under Company Home/Onboarding/Templates/Meeting-Notes. there9s a standard template that includes an Actions linked database and a Calendar field.

mina (new hire): found the page but when i click 'Use this template' it prompts for access. also curious if we have a naming convention for meeting pages (so they're easy to find).

access-bot: Notion access requests: https://redwood.internal/access-requests. include the Notion URL and your team. Docs + People Ops handle requests M-F.

ellie (Docs Owner): @mina you need to be in the `notes-editors` Notion group to duplicate templates that include the Actions DB template. i can grant a one-off copy if People Ops confirms your team.

karim (manager): confirmed mina is on infra-tools, please add her to notes-editors. Also quick policy: meeting notes that contain operational runbooks or escalation steps should be moved into Knowledge Base after review.

ellie (Docs Owner): added mina to notes-editors. try the template again. for naming we use: <YYYY-MM-DD> - <Team> - <Meeting Short Title> (e.g., 2026-02-10 - infra - weekly sync). add page props: Owner, Team, MeetingDate, Attendees, Outcome, NotesVersion.

mina (new hire): duplication worked, thanks! how do i wire action items to the global Tasks DB?

sam (DevEx): the template includes an "Actions" linked database that writes to /Company Home/Workflows/Tasks. when you duplicate from the canonical template (with notes-editors) the relation is preserved. if you duplicate without the group, you get a local copy of the DB and need to transfer items manually.

mina (new hire): sweet. one more: can we auto-create a calendar event link or integrate with Google Calendar from the page?

ellie (Docs Owner): we have an automation placeholder in the template for Calendar sync, but enabling live sync (Google calendar webhook) requires an infra ticket for auth: https://redwood.internal/infra-automation. include the page URL and the calendar email.

karim (manager): when you publish notes to the team space, set Visibility to team and tag @docs-review for a quick check if the notes reference any runbook steps. otherwise keep drafts in your Private space.

mina (new hire): great, all set. i'll publish the meeting notes after the sync and tag docs-review. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

access-bot: Reminder: page ownership transfers and automation enablement must go through access requests and infra-automation tickets respectively.
